references.text: The same construction with gold rings below the rim for carrying poles is described for the ark of the covenant.
The table for showbread also has four gold rings at its four corners for carrying poles, following the same principle as the incense altar.
Gold rings are mentioned as fastening devices in the tabernacle's construction.
The bronze altar also has rings at its four corners for carrying poles.
The next verse continues with instructions to make the carrying poles from acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
Describes the actual making of the rings and carrying poles for the table, parallel to the instructions here.
The actual making of the incense altar's gold rings below the molding on both sides.
A complementary verse describing the use of the rings mentioned in the source verse during transport.
